text:
alice (product-design): Heads-up — I noticed a mismatch between the in-product help pane copy and the docs glossary. The help pane in the Console uses 'route' but the docs and API refer to 'endpoint'. Causing confusion during onboarding.
ben (docs): Ugh, yeah. We started using 'route' when drafting the quickstart. Docs canonical term is 'endpoint'.
carla (devex): Do we have a canonical terms list? I thought glossary.md was the source of truth but maybe not synced with UI strings.
derek (frontend): The help panel is pulling copy from i18n keys (ui.help.quick_route) — we can swap to ui.help.quick_endpoint but need the product sign-off.
fiona (pm): We should pick one term and align. Recommend 'endpoint' since it's used across API and SDKs. Any objections?
alice (product-design): agree with endpoint. Also the in-product panel's 'learn more' link goes to an older docs anchor (/docs#routes) that 404s. We need a redirect or update.
ben (docs): I can add an anchor /docs/reference/endpoints and add a redirect for /docs#routes. Will need a quick PR.
maria (support): Customers hit this — just finished a support ticket where they were told to "check the route" and they looked in the SDK docs under endpoints and got confused.
derek (frontend): For the link, can we use a config-driven doc-url so we don't hardcode anchors in the bundle?
carla (devex): yes, we have docLinkService but not exposed to the help pane component. Little risky to inline hard links.
sam (design-engineering): Small UX ask: when the help panel opens, focus isn't moved to the panel, so screen reader users don't know content changed. a11y-bot flagged it in last audit.
a11y-bot: Accessibility note: ensure dialog role=dialog, set aria-modal=true, and call element.focus() on open. Also verify keyboard trap inside the panel.
fiona (pm): Ok action items: 1) docs: add anchor + redirect (ben) 2) frontend: switch i18n key and use docLinkService (derek) 3) a11y: focus trap + dialog attributes (derek + a11y-bot) 4) devex: maintain canonical term list (carla) 5) support: add internal KB note for now (maria).
ben (docs): I'll open a PR today for the anchor + redirect. Will ping once it's live.
derek (frontend): I'll prep a small patch to swap key and wire docLinkService. ETA EOD tomorrow.
carla (devex): I'll calendar a 30m sync to decide canonical term rules and where to store them (glossary vs i18n).
sam (design-engineering): I'll update the mock to show 'endpoint' in the panel and add a tiny tooltip explaining equivalence to older 'route' term for a month.
maria (support): I'll add a KB note and an example message agents can paste.
fiona (pm): Thanks team. If PRs land, can ops/infra trigger a doc deploy? @ben please tag docs-deploy once merged.
ben (docs): Will do.
a11y-bot: Reminder: include accessibility acceptance criteria in PR description.
alice (product-design): One more nit — the help panel copy uses "Learn more about routes" which will need updating to "Learn more about endpoints" and the tooltip language. Small copy PR incoming from me.
fiona (pm): Great. Let's reconvene after the doc deploy and frontend patch. :thumbsup:
ben (docs): tracked in GH issue #4523.
carla (devex): adding to our internal registry: canonical_term:endpoint.
derek (frontend): linking PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2876
maria (support): Marking customer ticket as 'waiting on internal docs update' and will follow up once you confirm.
alice (product-design): Thanks everyone — keeping this thread for final sign-off after deploy.
